text:
deploy-bot: :warning: Canary health check failing: /v1/generate 5xx spike detected in us-east-1 canary pool (canary tag=canary-2026-03-15b).

pagerduty: Incident created (P2). Assigned to sam.

sam: acked. looking into logs and stack traces. can someone grab recent error lines?

anya: grabbing logs. grep shows repeated KMS AccessDenied during model unwrap:
```
2026-03-15T18:12:34Z ERROR com.redwood.kms - decrypt failed: AccessDenied: arn:aws:iam::99999:role/redwood-service cannot perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/rotated-111
```

diego: new canary introduced per-tenant key override and sets REDWOOD_MODEL_KEY to the rotated key. Looks like the rotated key policy wasn't updated to include our service role.

iris: customer impact: about 9.6% 5xx for generate in that canary region. Two paying customers show elevated error rates (phoenix-data, blueharbor). No evidence of data leakage, failures are decrypt errors.

marta: can we flip the feature flag that enables per-tenant override for this canary? That would avoid rolling back full deploy.

sam: attempting feature-flag kill: `featurectl disable per_tenant_kms_override --env=canary`

ops-bot: Feature toggle API: per_tenant_kms_override disabled for canary cluster.

deploy-bot: Observability: routing remains to canary but override flag is off; canary pods still running. Monitoring 30s for error rate.

anya: 60s in: 5xx rate trending down. 120s: near baseline. Good sign.

marta: good catch. we avoided full rollback. root cause looks like missing kms:Decrypt permission on rotated key. Need immediate remediation and follow-ups.

sam: paging security and infra; assigning follow-up owners: diego -> add KMS key policy fix; iris -> notify impacted customers; anya -> add preflight check to deploy pipeline.

diego: fixing key policy now. adding service role ARN to key policy statements and testing. I'll also add a tag to keys created by our infra so we detect changes.

iris: notifying customers: sending short blurb to account teams and support channels. No SLA breach but customers should know transient errors occurred.

anya: prototype preflight: run kms:DescribeKey + a test decrypt using a small encrypted blob against the provided key id before allowing canary to accept traffic. Adding script to infra repo and PR shortly. Example check:
```
# preflight_kms_check.sh
aws kms describe-key --key-id $REDWOOD_MODEL_KEY || exit 2
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://small_encrypted_blob --key-id $REDWOOD_MODEL_KEY || exit 3
```

marta: excellent. two policy suggestions: (1) deploy pipeline should reject canary if REDWOOD_MODEL_KEY differs from stable unless `--force-kms-override` is provided, (2) require change approval from security when rotating keys referenced by service configs.

diego: implemented quick patch to key policy. verified decrypt works from service-role principal. Confirming logs now show no AccessDenied.

ops-bot: Canary metrics: 5xx back to baseline. Incident status: mitigated.

sam: timeline for postmortem: canary rolled at 18:10:02, errors began 18:12:34, feature flag disabled 18:13:10, metrics normalized 18:15:12.

marta: create incident ticket and postmortem stub. include logs, the key-policy diff, and the infra PR for preflight check. tag security for approval of the policy change.

sam: created ticket INC-2026-4122 and linked PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1012 (preflight), and https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/421 (key policy change).

anya: adding deploy gate that rejects pipeline runs if env var REDWOOD_MODEL_KEY points to a key without decrypt access for the service role. PR ready for review.

diego: also writing short runbook entry: "kms-rotation-and-canary-safety.md" with steps for rotation and how to validate principals. Linking in ticket.

iris: customer comms posted to internal support channel and outreach scheduled for two impacted accounts.

marta: handing over to diego and anya for remediation items. I'll check postmortem and sign off. Thanks team for quick coordination. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-4122 updated to RESOLVED (mitigated). Postmortem link placeholder: https://docs.redwood/infrapostmortems/INC-2026-4122/draft

sam: closing on-call handoff notes: follow-ups assigned: diego (key policy finish + audit), anya (pipeline preflight + merge), marta (postmortem review), iris (customer updates).

marta: confirming I will review postmortem before end of day. Closing thread after postmortem link is final.

deploy-bot: Attachments: logs, metric graphs, key policy diff, and PR links added to incident ticket.

marta: closing. :white_check_mark:
